target: 모든 기능과 사용 결과의 동등성. 사용자 승인 없이 기능 범위를 줄이지 않는다.
completionDefinition: 전수 조사에서 발견한 기능마다 화면·입력·상태 전이·영속 데이터·출력·연동 결과를 대응시킨다.
공식 소개, 녹화 데모, 실제 앱 관찰, 실제 실행 검증을 서로 다른 증거로 관리한다.
버튼 노출이나 모의 데이터만으로 기능 완료로 판정하지 않는다.
독립 세션·새로고침·재접속·출력 파일·외부 연동 결과를 기능에 맞게 검증한다.
원본 기능 자체가 미확인인 항목은 추정 구현을 동일 구현으로 보고하지 않는다.

blockers.detail: Current Free Settings/Menu and product/board subset observed. Complete route/menu/state audit, paid accounts and supplier-role screens remain unavailable or incomplete.
AI, Google, mail, Stripe and Pinterest adapters exist; real external accounts/delivery/generation/charges are unverified. Original supplier directory and external approval workflows are unconnected.

445 explicitly named source SKUs enriched with 1036 API assets, 25 unique GLBs reused by 412 SKUs and 33 source alpha planes. The complete source database, model/template catalog and all advertised file formats are not acquired.
Exact trial enrollment/500 credits/expiry/reminders, external designer/education/supplier approval, original organization memberships and account deletion remain incomplete.
PAT, SketchUp and Team code is present but was not rendered in observed Free Settings. Studio is Coming soon; no assumption of enabled paid/flagged functionality is made.

Public landing is newly implemented, but source scroll animation/pixel parity, Chinese localization, original contact/demo delivery and booking, source editorial/customer content, and source legal-policy documents are not fully reproduced. These gaps are tracked rather than removed from the target.

discrepancies.detail: 공동 편집·역할 소개와 Studio 예고 권한 항목 사이의 실제 요금제 경계를 계정에서 검증해야 함.
가격표는 Plus 월 2500 크레딧, 현재 가입 화면은 10일 체험 500 크레딧을 안내함. 정규·체험 정책을 구분해야 함.
과거 Paper 검색 색인의 AI 세부 기능은 현행 경로가 리디렉트되므로 현행 제공 확정으로 취급하지 않음.
Current Free Settings does not render Team/PAT/SketchUp. Public Studio remains Coming soon. Public code presence does not establish paid/free availability.

The current source Board is an infinite 2D product/image canvas. The older recorded 3D material-board workflow is retained as a separate local mode; these surfaces are not treated as one identical current editor.
Actual source furniture descriptors can be alpha-plane image samples. F3001216 has no source chair mesh, while 412 other imported SKU records reuse 25 GLB files.

The original home has 35 observed hero products, customer logos and testimonials. Local hero assets are source-backed; customer claims are replaced by factual catalog brands and nine original workflow guides. English only, route-based signup, demo preview tabs and local policy notes are explicit differences.

features.implementationNote: Actual imported meshes preserve proportions and nested transforms, center/ground, fit portrait/landscape cameras, and report load errors. Raw source GLBs are reused across source SKUs.

features.name: 원본 HDR 환경 조명
features.acceptance: 실제 입력·저장·접근 범위·출력과 원본 관찰 범위를 구분해 검증한다.
features.implementationNote: The exact observed source HDR file is locally bundled and hash verified. Matching environment alone does not certify identical lighting or rendering.

features.name: 공개 랜딩·작업 공간 진입 분리
features.acceptance: /와 /landing은 공개 소개를 표시하고 /catalog는 작업 공간을 열며, 랜딩이 작업 공간 API나 인증을 기다리지 않는지 확인한다.
features.implementationNote: Initially absent public landing was added. Marketing paths render before workspace loading/auth and skip workspace bootstrap; /products and /app remain catalog aliases. This does not make the workspace API-independent. Root verified the built dist in a fresh browser served without API:35 hero images, heading, zero broken images, zero console errors/warnings and zero API requests.

features.name: 랜딩 헤더·푸터와 소개 페이지 연결
features.acceptance: 노출된 메뉴·CTA가 실제 로컬 페이지나 작업 공간 목적지로 연결되는지 대조한다.
features.implementationNote: Products, Explore/workflow, pricing, board, schedule, samples, supplier overview, about, guides, login/signup and local policy destinations are connected. Source URL aliases are retained where implemented; this is not a certification of every source menu/state.

features.name: 원본 35개 hero 자산과 제품 진입
features.acceptance: 관찰한 제품 이미지·수량·링크를 확인하고 원본 스크롤·시각 동작 차이를 기록한다.
features.implementationNote: All 35 observed floating product images are bundled and displayed. Named local product matches open actual product queries; unmatched items fall back to a name search. Original scroll choreography, animation timing and pixel-level geometry are not exhaustively matched or certified.

features.name: 랜딩 검색·분류·제품 의도의 인증 후 복원
features.acceptance: 검색어·분류·제품 식별자를 카탈로그로 전달하고 로그인 이후에도 유지하며 외부 복귀 주소는 차단한다.
features.implementationNote: Root observed Ceragni search reaching the catalog query with 192 matching results, all Ceragni. Catalog q/type/product parsing and same-origin workspace returnTo validation are covered by three navigation tests. Lexical search does not claim the source semantic/Agentic Search behavior.

features.name: 로그인·가입 실제 폼 진입
features.acceptance: /login은 로그인, /signup과 /register는 계정 생성 폼으로 연결되는지 확인한다.
features.implementationNote: Signup opens the actual Create account form; root inspected the form without entering data or creating an account during this landing QA. Existing authentication APIs remain in use. The source desktop registration dialog is not identically reproduced.

features.name: Explore 이동과 모바일 메뉴
features.acceptance: Explore가 workflow 위치로 이동하고 작은 화면의 메뉴가 실제로 열리는지 확인한다.
features.implementationNote: Root observed the #workflow destination, mobile navigation opening at 390px, and zero horizontal overflow at that viewport. Other screen sizes, source menu state transitions and exact responsive equality are not exhaustively certified. Root additionally verified Escape closes the mobile navigation and restores focus to Open navigation; document width390 equals the390px viewport.

features.name: 고객사·후기 섹션의 사실 기반 대체
features.acceptance: 원본 고객 실적을 로컬 서비스 실적으로 오인하지 않도록 콘텐츠와 출처를 구분한다.
features.implementationNote: Original customer logos and testimonials were excluded. The local page uses factual catalog brands and nine original workflow guides. These are deliberate substitutions, not replicated endorsements or source testimonial parity.

features.name: 보드·사양표·샘플 소개와 작업 공간 CTA
features.acceptance: 기능 소개에서 실제 보드·사양표·제품 탐색 진입으로 이어지는지 확인한다.
features.implementationNote: /material-board, /schedule, /material-samples and /virtual-samples provide local workflow descriptions and existing product screenshots with working workspace CTAs. Source legal/marketing long-form text is not copied; source layout and every FAQ are not certified identical.

features.name: 공개 요금표와 설정 진입
features.acceptance: 월간·연간 선택과 요금 표시를 확인하고 실제 플랜 설정 진입 및 미연결 상태를 구분한다.
features.implementationNote: /pricing switches monthly/annual values and routes available plans to /catalog?settings=plan. Studio is disabled as Coming soon. Visiting the page grants no plan or trial; actual external billing remains subject to the existing service-connection boundary. Root verified annual Free0/Starter6/Plus21/Studio50 USD per month and the disabled Studio Coming soon control.

features.name: 공급사·회사·자료 소개 페이지
features.acceptance: 소개 링크가 유효한 콘텐츠와 실제 기능 진입을 제공하고 원본과 다른 자료를 구분한다.
features.implementationNote: /virtual-showroom links to the local supplier console; /about and /articles provide local product descriptions and original workspace guides. The source company narrative, entire editorial archive and third-party supplier enrollment are not replicated.

features.name: 데모 요청 목적지와 workflow 미리보기
features.acceptance: /request-demo의 실제 제공 기능과 원본 영업 제출·예약 연결 여부를 구분한다.
features.implementationNote: The local page has three interactive workflow preview tabs and a workspace CTA. Original required sales-form fields, source submission delivery and external Calendly booking are not implemented or connected; the page explicitly discloses the missing booking service. No form or booking was submitted. Root verified ArrowRight selects Build a board and the selected tab matches the tabpanel accessible name.

features.name: 쿠키 설정 모달
features.acceptance: Cookie settings가 실제 모달을 열고 Escape로 닫히며 설치의 실제 추적 설정을 설명하는지 확인한다.
features.implementationNote: Root observed the cookie dialog and Escape dismissal. It documents required session cookies and unconfigured analytics/advertising. No optional tracker or source consent-platform preference storage is claimed.

features.name: 개인정보·약관 목적지의 로컬 안내
features.acceptance: 정책 링크가 열리고 로컬 preview notes를 원본 법률 계약이나 승인된 운영 약관으로 표시하지 않는지 확인한다.
features.implementationNote: /privacy and /privacy-statement, /terms and /terms-of-use display original local-preview notes about storage, sharing and optional services. Source legal prose and operator identity are not copied. These are not the source legal documents or approved production policies.

features.name: 원본 Contact us 폼·외부 전송
features.acceptance: 원본 연락 폼의 입력·제출·실제 수신을 구현·검증하기 전까지 미구현으로 유지한다.
features.implementationNote: The observed source footer contact modal posts to api/v1/contact/submit. No corresponding monogram contact form, source endpoint call or delivery adapter is implemented/connected. The demo preview does not stand in for a successfully delivered sales request.

features.name: 원본 중국어 랜딩 전환
features.acceptance: 원본 영어·중국어 전환과 번역 경로를 대응시키고 실제 지원 언어를 표시한다.
features.implementationNote: The source exposes English and Simplified Chinese and a /zh path. This local landing is English-only; no translated Chinese route, menu or language switch is implemented.

features.name: 공개 랜딩 자산의 출처·해시 보존
features.acceptance: 관찰한 URL에서 받은 자산의 목록·수량·파일 크기·SHA-256을 확인하고 카탈로그를 보존한다.
features.implementationNote: 46 observed assets (35 hero, 8 features, 3 backgrounds) exist locally and match recorded byte counts and SHA-256. Source customer logos/testimonials are excluded. The 445-product catalog hash remained unchanged.

authenticatedAuditBoundary: Root observed current Free Menu, Profile, Account & security, Plan & credits, Integrations and Appearance. Team, PAT and SketchUp were not rendered in that account. Full Library/Projects/Style Passport, paid tiers and supplier-role source flows remain unaudited.
excludedFalsePositives: Arcade의 전체화면·재생·링크복사·워터마크는 데모 플레이어 기능이며 원본 서비스 기능으로 집계하지 않음.
과거 녹화의 Paper 항목과 현재 공개 경로의 존재를 동일하게 취급하지 않음.
